validate-jwt.failed-validation-error-message: Unauthorized. Missing or invalid access token.

otherwise.choose:
<when condition="@{
					var jwt = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("validated-jwt");
					if (jwt == null) { return false; }

					// --- app id check ---
                    var allowedAppId = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("allowed-app-id", "");
		            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(allowedAppId)) { return false; }   
                    string callerAppId = null;
                    string[] claimVal;
                    if (jwt.Claims.TryGetValue("appid", out claimVal) && claimVal != null && claimVal.Length > 0) {
                        callerAppId = claimVal[0]; // v1.0 token
                    }
                    else if (jwt.Claims.TryGetValue("azp", out claimVal) && claimVal != null && claimVal.Length > 0) {
                        callerAppId = claimVal[0]; // v2.0 token
                    }

                    return !string.IsNullOrEmpty(callerAppId) &&
                        callerAppId.Trim().Equals(allowedAppId.Trim(), StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
	
				}">
				
				
					
						
						
							application/json
						
						{"statusCode": 403, "message": "Forbidden. Token does not have the required permission."}
